title: 49GAION Library - release notice
description: A notice from a design stage to the stage after it, sent on every filing of a decided release. It points to the filed release by reference; it never carries release text, atom text or the name of a person. notice_id is the sending stage's prefix, 'N-', and the SHA-256 of the canonical notice without notice_id (keys sorted, separators ',' and ':', UTF-8, non-ASCII kept). A stage's own notice contract may narrow any field (a pattern, a value, a count); it never adds or removes one.

rests_on.description: The decided releases this release was designed from; empty for a stage that rests on sources only.

filed_ref.description: The filed copy of the release in Source Lifecycle, as its filing receipt names it.

final_status.description: The decided final status, in the sending stage's own words; only a decided release is announced.

final_status_ref.description: The decision reference in Source Lifecycle.

answers.description: The design returns this release answers; may be empty.
